issues.assessment: All seven sources are dated 1863–1880 by original editorial bounds; none is eligible as 1851–55 correspondence. The repeated XML lower bound 1809 is metadata fallback, not historical evidence.
3887 includes four available diagrams; the numbered phyllotaxy plots were visually inspected. No additional visual assets for the other records were available in the preserved figure inventory.
